text:
Maya: Heads up — customer X asked for a signed base-image rebuild this Thurs. KMS key rotation is also scheduled that day. We need to coordinate signer RBAC, audit log retention, and canary timing. :lock:
Sam: Oof, same window as a couple of our Dedicated cutovers. Do we have a hard requirement to rotate the KMS key that day or can we slide? :thinking:
Lucas: We can probably shift rotation 48h, but need sign-off from infra and compliance. If we move the key rotation after the image rollout we avoid re-signing artifacts.
Maya: Compliance prefers rotation within the currently approved window, but they said exceptions ok with a justification. I'll ping them. Also, cosign + KMS notes below for the signer agent (for whoever lands the signer RBAC):
```bash
COSIGN_KMS_URI=projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/img-signer
cosign sign --kms $COSIGN_KMS_URI --annotations image=redwood/base:2026-03-20 ./image.tar
```
Maya: Important: only the signer service account should have "cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign" and no raw decryption permissions. Audit logs MUST be exported to the long-term retention bucket (retention=365 days) for compliance. :memo:
Irene: On RBAC — suggest creating a single group `image-signers` and grant it a narrow IAM role that only allows KMS sign + Artifact Registry upload. No admin roles. Who owns the group?
Lucas: We can create the group in IAM, sec will own membership. Minimal policy example (pseudo-JSON):
```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {"role": "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier", "members": ["group:image-signers@redwood.com"]},
    {"role": "roles/artifactregistry.writer", "members": ["group:image-signers@redwood.com"]}
  ]
}
```
Sam: Triage update: image scan found a glibc advisory (CVE-2026-12345) flagged as moderate due to feature usage. I'm proposing we run the canary on staging clusters only and hold back global rollout until we validate runtime tests. :mag:
Maya: Agree. Plan: 1) shift KMS rotation by 48h if compliance OK; 2) create `image-signers` group and apply the policy above; 3) run staging canary with smoke tests; 4) export audit logs to retention bucket; 5) finalize incident playbook update.
Sam: I can run the canary and smoke tests. Smoke script here: `infra/scripts/image-smoke.sh --target=staging --timeout=15m`
deploy-bot: Scheduled: image-signing job will run 2026-03-18T22:00Z, canary deploy 2026-03-18T23:30Z (automated entry).
Irene: Please add a short section to the incident playbook for "failed signer key rotation during rollout" (who to page, rollback path, emergency key reuse policy). I'll draft the section and drop it in the playbook. :pencil2:
Maya: Thanks — assigning tasks: @Irene update playbook, @Lucas create group + IAM bindings, @Sam run canary + report back. I'll handle compliance outreach to request the 48h defer. Ping me in-thread if you hit blockers. :seedling:
Sam: Will do. Updating the ticket with the canary logs after run. :thumbsup:
Maya: Closing loop later today after compliance reply. If rotation can't be moved we'll need to schedule a re-sign window and communicate to customers. :eyes:
